statement.zh: 东方研究所伊拉克队 1932/33 季初步结果（当时记录的迪亚拉/豪尔萨巴德工作）见 Frankfort OIC 17（1934）。
statement.en: 1932/33-season preliminary results of the Oriental Institute Iraq Expedition (Diyala/Khorsabad work as then recorded) are documented in Frankfort OIC 17 (1934).
